messages:
Sam: quick heads-up: Next.js app-router + our JS SDK hitting edge runtime errors for some customers. Error shows 'require is not a function' during SSR hydration. Repro in a small repo I made.

Rohit: short repro helpful. is this caused by CJS entrypoints?

Sam: yes — one lib reads config from disk at import time and that pulls node builtins into the graph, bundler flips to CJS and edge runtime chokes.

Leah: common pattern: move fs calls into async init or route handler. Also shipping an ESM-first build + CJS shim usually helps.

Sam: I tested dynamic import workaround in server component:
```js
const mod = await import('redwood-sdk');
const client = mod?.default ?? mod;
```
works in many cases. Need docs + example.

Rohit: Action items: 1) Add examples/next-app-edge-esm with no top-level node imports. 2) Update package.json exports to provide import/require paths. 3) Ship index.d.ts with export default types.

CI Bot: opened PR #813 with initial exports + example. Tests failing on node 14.

Sam: perfect — I'll add a short docs note about avoiding static requires in app-router server modules. Thanks all :thumbsup:
